title: After completing a verse, the quest journal's 'remaining locations' text keeps listing the just-finished location instead of dropping it, contradicting the status line directly above it. Example: right after learning the water verse, status showed 'Verses: 1/3 (unexplored: old watchtower, barrow hall)' but the quest line still read 'One verse known. Two more: the sunken shrine and the old watchtower east of the wood, and the barrow's hall.' Same happened after the wind verse ('The third waits — shrine, tower, or the barrow's own hall' when only the barrow hall was left).
where: status screen / quest 'The Three Verses', after Sunken Shrine and Old Watchtower
